results.title: “We will clean Yamuna before May 2029”: Amit Shah vows to clean Yamuna river
results.content: Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Thursday launched a scathing attack on the AAP and Congress, holding both parties responsible for the severe pollution of the Yamuna River. Pledging that the BJP will restore the water body, Shah vowed that the party will clean the Yamuna before May 2029. The remarks were made during a major public event in the capital where the senior leader outlined the government’s upcoming developmental roadmap and environmental priorities for Delhi.
